title: CapabilityPermissionContract

definitions.capability: A documented ability or reusable ecosystem function.
definitions.permission: A policy expression that allows or restricts use of a capability under explicit conditions.
definitions.authority: The governed right or delegated basis to permit a consequential action.
definitions.consent: An applicable affirmative, informed and bounded authorization where consent is required.

providerRules: Provider availability does not imply authority.
Provider identity does not become the canonical capability identity.
External provider output is evidence/input, not automatic truth.
Adapters must preserve capability semantics and expose explicit degraded health.
